<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE vxml PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD VOICEXML 2.1//EN" "https://www.w3.org/TR/voicexml21/vxml.dtd">
<vxml version="2.1" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/vxml"><form id="bill_dispute"><field name="choice"><prompt>If the amount is > 50 we route you to an agent.</prompt><grammar type="application/srgs+xml" src="grammars/bill_dispute.grxml"/><filled><submit next="/ivr/handle/bill_dispute" namelist="choice"/></filled></field></form></vxml>
